source_recipe_holds: TVPO:piperazine stoichiometry remains 1:1 versus 2:3 in the source. SS1-specific 5 min drying steps are explicitly stated in main and SI. Exact AgNO3 solution volume and precursor masses are not reported.
washing_protocol: One accelerated wash operation simulating five home laundry cycles: sandwich a 152.4 × 50.8 mm specimen between two multifiber test fabrics and stitch the edges. Use 0.225 g ECE 98 detergent, 150 mL demineralized water and 50 steel balls in an Atlas Launder-O-Meter LEF at 49 °C for 45 min. Rinse three times with demineralized water, dry at 60 °C for 2 h and condition in standard atmosphere for 24 h before other characterization. SI-4 prepares three wash specimens per sample. The main and SI heading cite AATCC 61-1996; SI procedural text and silver durability prose cite AATCC 61-2013, so standard edition remains source-conflicted.

treatment_method: Apply aqueous TVPO/piperazine to cotton in a petri dish, stand 15 min and dry at 60 °C for 5 min. Main section 2.2.3.1 sprays AgNO3 solution to target 0.1 wt% Ag, keeps the fabric dark for 15 min, then dries at 60 °C for 5 min. Steam at 110 °C and 0.4 bar above atmospheric pressure for 1 h. Wash and condition as specified. Actual P before/after washing is 2.14 ± 0.29% / 2.08 ± 0.08%, and actual Ag is 0.08 ± 0.01% after washing. One accelerated wash operation simulating five home laundry cycles: sandwich a 152.4 × 50.8 mm specimen between two multifiber test fabrics and stitch the edges. Use 0.225 g ECE 98 detergent, 150 mL demineralized water and 50 steel balls in an Atlas Launder-O-Meter LEF at 49 °C for 45 min. Rinse three times with demineralized water, dry at 60 °C for 2 h and condition in standard atmosphere for 24 h before other characterization. SI-4 prepares three wash specimens per sample. The main and SI heading cite AATCC 61-1996; SI procedural text and silver durability prose cite AATCC 61-2013, so standard edition remains source-conflicted.

conditions_locator: Final article p 4, sections 2.1 and 2.2.2-2.2.6; SI pp 6-9, sections SI-3.3 through SI-4. TG: approximately 4 mg, 25-800 °C, N2 and air, total gas flow 50 mL/min, 10 °C/min. Wash procedure: SI p 9.
pairing_evidence: Main Table 2 explicitly reports fire tests after five wash cycles. SI-4 states rinsed, dried and conditioned washed samples precede other characterization and analysis. For each treated fabric, Table SI-5 TG repeats the exact phosphorus value and uncertainty in the post-five-wash Table 1/SI-3/SI-4 column and main LOI Table 2. Labels and P values jointly identify the same states. Blank appears in both assay tables; Table 2 all-samples wash footnote and shared characterization procedure apply. No 50-wash state or neat polymer is substituted.
source_location: Official institutional 14-page final published PDF and 22-page supplement. Main p 4 methods and p 6 LOI Table 2; SI p 15 TG Table SI-5, pp 6-8 recipes and p 9 washing. Main method/LOI and SI method/TG pixels reviewed; no graph digitization.
limitations: Eight prepared textile/wash states with sixteen atmospheric TG conditions. All LOI rows are after five simulated home laundry cycles, not unwashed. Source recipe conflicts are preserved separately: piperazine ratio 1:1 versus 2:3, and general pre-steam drying 10 versus 5 min. These unresolved recipe details are not silently chosen or used to manufacture additional states. Source onset is 97% mass remaining excluding moisture and is not recast as T5/T10. Tdmax is explicitly the maximum mass-loss-rate DTG peak. LOI ±0.2 has no stated uncertainty type and is not labelled SD; mean uses five specimens. Three prepared wash specimens do not establish TG replicate count. Table 3 contains MCC temperatures and residues and is excluded. Poly-A/Poly-B are neat synthesized polymers, not fabrics. Fifty-wash variants, dry/microwave controls and unused steam recipes lack matched measured TG/LOI and remain held. Table 4 uses representative chemistry names and rounds TPTEPO LOI to 27.4; no add-on or label crosswalk is inferred from that comparison table. Source laundering standard editions conflict; explicit physical wash conditions are retained.
